test_s2s_transformer_checkpoint: test the s2s transformer checkpoint model using the s2u_transformer_reduced_fisher.pt checkpoint with BLEU scoring
run_s2s_transformer_tests: run the unittest suite for the speech-to-speech transformer model using python unittest
setup_s2s_test_fixtures: set up test fixtures for s2s transformer including dev_shuf200.tsv, src_feat.zip, and vocoder config files
postprocess_s2s_tokens: postprocess target and hypothesis tokens into string representations using the tgt_dict string method
strip_pad_tokens: strip padding tokens from target sequences using utils.strip_pad before converting to strings
